title: Crestline Credit Card Reduction on Readjustment Parts — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
On an Alignment Services & Plans readjustment, a cardholder readjustment parts reduction takes a percentage of the parts amount off the parts charge. It is read from the customer's Crestline Credit Card account and the late fees posted to it in the 12 calendar months up to the plan desk's booking of the readjustment.

| Customer's Crestline Credit Card account | Late fee posted in the 12 calendar months up to the booking | Reduction, as a percentage of the parts amount |
|---|---|---|
| Active | none | 6% |
| Active | one or more | 3% |
| No active account | — | 0% |

The reduction is worked out on its own, as a percentage of the parts amount, and taken off the parts charge, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

*Hypothetical:* on a parts amount of 50.00, 3.00 is taken off for an active account with no late fee in the period, and 1.50 with one.
